Slop Signature · free, in your browser

Make an HTML email signature

Build the signature in the form and take it as HTML: tables and inline styles, the way mail programs expect, with every typed value escaped. Copy the code, or download a ready .html file.

Make an HTML signature

How to do it

  1. Fill in your details, social links, a line to click, and any small print such as a disclaimer or company number.
  2. Pick a Template, Colour, Font and Picture size.
  3. Choose Copy HTML code to put the HTML on the clipboard, or Download HTML for a file.
  4. Paste the code into your mail program, signature manager or help desk tool.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Signature runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Why tables and inline styles?

Many mail programs ignore style sheets and modern layout, so signatures built with tables and inline styles look the same in more of them.

Are the links safe?

Links get https:// added when missing, email and phone become mailto: and tel: links, and anything such as javascript: is never made a link.

Is there a watermark or a link back?

No. The HTML has only your signature, with no credit line and no tracking.
